newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends lower for sixth straight session.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends lower for sixth straight session.

text.p: Uncertainty about the course of UK monetary and fiscal policy, a further appreciation in the value of sterling and a weak start on Wall Street conspired to drive leading British shares lower for the sixth straight session.
The benchmark FTSE 100 share index closed down 18.1 points to 4,575.8, as decliners beat advancers 59 to 35.

The stock index futures market set the weaker tone in the market, falling to a steep discount to the spot index initially, as worries about interest rates and the upcoming July 2 budget took their toll.
